title: Real Estate Website
description: Property listing template with slug pages, RERA fields, admin CRM, and lead export.

blocks.text: Use tempjs real-estate to generate a property listing site. The admin portal manages projects/properties, leads, and promo content. Demo brand: Greenfield Properties (Pune). Property pages support RERA numbers and new-launch badges.

items: Property grid with apartments / plots tabs
RERA fields on listings and legal consent

blocks.text: Besides standard brand and contact flags, real-estate init supports tagline, developer name, channel partner, and agent RERA number (legal.agentRera) used in consent and footer.
Hotel templates use --temple-distance for a landmark line instead of --agent-rera. Each template's applicable flags are listed in templates.json init.brandFields.

blocks.code:
mkdir greenfield-client && cd greenfield-client
tempjs real-estate config

# Non-interactive full setup
tempjs real-estate --config --yes \
  --theme theme2 --font elegant \
  --name "Greenfield Properties" \
  --short-name "Greenfield" \
  --base-url https://greenfieldproperties.com \
  --phone 9123456780 \
  --email hello@greenfieldproperties.com \
  --address "Baner, Pune, Maharashtra, India" \
  --tagline "Homes & Investments You Can Trust" \
  --agent-rera A52100012345 \
  --db-host localhost --db-name greenfield_db --admin-user admin --admin-password changeme
